      int checkCount()
      The one call that goes and finds out. Clicks Check and waits up to 2.5 seconds for the game to answer. Returns the count, or -1 if no bag is carried. If the game says nothing in time it logs that and returns whatever it knew before. XPE method.
      void forget()
      Drops the tracked count back to -1, for a script that knows the bag changed behind its back. contains and isEm pty while unknown. Both answer false, which is the safe direction for contains and the surprising one for isEmpty. An unknown bag is never reported as empty. Test count() == -1 yourself when you need to tell "unknown" apart from "empty". Moving coal. XPE method.
      boolean fill()
      Fills the bag. From the bank when the bank is open, otherwise from the inventory. XPE method.
      boolean empty()
      Empties the bag. Into the bank when the bank is open, otherwise into the inventory. The return value is "did anything move".false m eans nothing shifted: the bag was already full, there was no coal to take, or there was nowhere to put it. Both calls keep the tracked count in step by m easuring the difference. The bank behaviour is the game's, not an extra step. A coal bag's own Fill and Em pty act on the bank whenever the bank interface is open, so a banking script calls empty() with the bank open and the coal goes straight in. Opening and closing An open coal bag is a separate item , and m ining with it open needs no clicks. XPE method.
      boolean open()
      Opens a closed bag, so mined coal goes into it automatically. XPE method.
      boolean close()
      Closes an open bag. Two items, one bag. The open kind is nam ed Open coal bag. bag() and has() find either; isOpen() tells them apart. XPE method.
